answer: Each Sybil identity must post collateral c, so n clones lock n·c while quadratic slashing erodes stake by n²c, driving marginal attack cost dC/dn = c + 2nc strictly upward. Attack spend thus scales O(n²) versus linear extraction v·n; an island economy of value V stays secure when n²c > V for all n, so c ≥ V/n² at honest quorum sustains consensus.
